title: CORE-04 Complete Generic Capability Matrix: Full Fallback & Multi-Tier Model Qualification
purpose: Complete 100% dual-fallback coverage for generic extraction (core.extract on lfm25-1p2b-thinking-local), establish fast-worker qualification (lfm25-1p2b-instruct-local across classify/summarize/extract), and edge-worker qualification (lfm25-350m-local on classify).
problem: core.extract lacks a secondary qualified fallback, and lightweight edge/fast tiers are unqualified, limiting local-first tiering across high-throughput and constrained hardware.

included: Benchmark Lab evaluation of lfm25-1p2b-thinking-local on core-extract-v1
Benchmark Lab evaluation of lfm25-1p2b-instruct-local on core-classify-v1, core-summarize-v1, core-extract-v1
Benchmark Lab evaluation of lfm25-350m-local on core-classify-v1
Evidence promotion and qualification records with canonical checksums
Model manifest updates for lfm25-1p2b-thinking-local, lfm25-1p2b-instruct-local, and lfm25-350m-local
Routing and runtime fallback verification for core.extract
excluded: Modifying existing completed Lighthouse, DealSniper, or llama3.2 qualification evidence

acceptanceCriteria.description: Benchmark Lab suite core-extract-v1 evaluates lfm25-1p2b-thinking-local, passes semantic evaluation across strata, and generates approved evidence.
Benchmark Lab suites core-classify-v1, core-summarize-v1, and core-extract-v1 evaluate lfm25-1p2b-instruct-local, pass semantic evaluation across strata, and generate approved evidence.
Benchmark Lab suite core-classify-v1 evaluates lfm25-350m-local, passes semantic evaluation across strata, and generates approved evidence.
Qualification records with canonical checksums are loaded into Local Brain for all new model roles, updating model manifests.
Execution of core.extract automatically falls back to secondary qualified model when primary fails, emitting Track Run Records with fallback metadata.
All existing repository validation commands (npm run test:full) remain 100% green.
